acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Data-independent acquisition; Bottom-up proteomics

alkylation_concentration.evidence: For in vivo and in vitro phosphoproteome samples, lysates or proteins on beads respectively were reduced with 1 mM DTT for 20 min, alkylated with 5.5 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) and digested with 1:100 Lys-C (Merck, US1324796) for 4h at room temperature on a rotor.

After dilution of urea concentration to 1M with 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 8, samples were digested with 1:100 trypsin (Promega, V5113) overnight.

enrichment_method.evidence: Samples were resuspended in 200 μL 80 % acetonitrile with 0.1 % trifluoroacetic acid in deionized water for phosphopeptides enrichment using Fe(III)-NTA cartridges (Agilent, Post et al, J. Proteome Res. 2017, 16, 2, 728–737 ).
